minimum_evidence_or_action: Obtain current registry evidence; do not infer from a website
Match signing authority to current official documents
Independently confirm official contact channels
Request model, grade, dimensions, tolerances and applicable standards
Ask for monthly capacity and documented current utilization
Distinguish manufacturer, trader and country of origin
Verify certificate scope and issuing body where applicable
Request anonymized sample batch traceability record
Ask for documented acceptance criteria
Agree sampling and acceptance method in contract
Specify inspector, scope and cost allocation
State rule, named place and version explicitly
Check current sanctions, licensing and end-use rules
Confirm classification with competent customs adviser
Specify dimensions, net/gross weight and destination requirements
Record dates and delay remedies
Define invoice, packing list, origin and required certificates
Match beneficiary to contracting legal entity
Use legally permitted channels; do not bypass sanctions
Approve representative sample before volume order
Specify return, repair, replacement or credit process
Obtain legal review for cross-border contract
Confirm ownership and permission for marks/designs
Document alternative supply and recovery time
Date each document and verify validity
Record accountable approver and unresolved exceptions
